title: Multitask Learning Can Improve Worst-Group Outcomes

bias_targets.target: Demographic bias (Gender, Race, Religion, Sexual orientation)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating worst-group accuracy on the CivilComments dataset by computing performance across 16 overlapping groups formed by the Cartesian product of binary toxicity labels and 8 demographic identities (male, female, LGBTQ, Christian, Muslim, other religions, Black, and White).

Measuring worst-group accuracy on the Waterbirds dataset (evaluating reliance on the spurious correlation between bird species and image background) and the MultiNLI dataset (evaluating reliance on the spurious correlation between textual entailment labels and the presence of negation words).
